data.name: Create JIRA issue
data.description: Working only through the Interceptor and Postman Chrome app
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a Jira issue through the Jira REST API. Use it to add a new issue from an external workflow.
Use for: create Jira issue, add issue from GitHub, open tracked work item
Not supported: updating issues, searching issues, managing comments

data.name: POST integrationJiraServerUpsert
data.evaluateGuide:
A POST endpoint associated with Groove's Jira server integration. Its supplied metadata does not specify the payload or the exact integration operation.
Use for: invoke Jira server integration, submit integration data, trigger server upsert
Not supported: issue creation details, issue search, issue retrieval

data.name: Store development information
data.description: Stores development information provided in the request to make it available when viewing issues in Jira. Existing repository and entity data for the same ID will be replaced if the updateSequenceId of existing data is less than the incoming data. Submissions are performed asynchronously. Submitted data will eventually be available in Jira; most updates are available within a short period of time, but may take some time during peak load and/or maintenance times.
data.evaluateGuide:
Stores or replaces development information for Jira issues, repositories, and related entities. Processing is asynchronous, so submitted data becomes available later.
Use for: submit development data, update repository links, attach development entities
Not supported: reading development data, creating Jira issues, synchronous confirmation

data.name: Submit Security Workspaces to link
data.description:
Insert Security Workspace IDs to establish a relationship between them and the Jira site the app is installed on. If a relationship between the workspace ID and Jira already exists then the workspace ID will be ignored and Jira will process the rest of the entries.
Only Connect apps that define the jiraSecurityInfoProvider module can access this resource.
This resource requires the 'WRITE' scope for Connect apps.
data.evaluateGuide:
Links Security Workspace IDs to the Jira site where an app is installed. Existing links are retained while new valid links are processed.
Use for: link security workspace, associate workspace IDs, bulk-submit security links
Not supported: unlinking workspaces, reading linked workspaces, managing vulnerabilities

data.name: Submit Incident or Review data
data.description:
Update / insert Incident or Review data.
Incidents and reviews are identified by their ID, and existing Incident and Review data for the same ID will be replaced if it exists and the updateSequenceNumber of existing data is less than the incoming data.
Submissions are performed asynchronously. Submitted data will eventually be available in Jira; most updates are available within a short period of time, but may take some time during peak load and/or maintenance times. The getIncidentById or getReviewById o
data.evaluateGuide:
Submits or replaces Incident and Review data for Jira operations. Processing is asynchronous, and submitted records can be checked later by ID.
Use for: submit incident data, submit review data, update operation records
Not supported: retrieving records, deleting incidents, synchronous completion

data.name: Register modules
data.description:
Register modules
Registers a list of modules.
Permissions required: Only Connect apps can make this request.
Response Codes

200 Returned if the request is successful.
400 Returned if:
any of the provided modules is invalid. For example, required properties are missing.
401 Returned if the call is not from a Connect app.
data.evaluateGuide:
Registers a list of dynamic modules for a Jira Connect app. Use it to add or update app module definitions on the Jira platform.
Use for: register app modules, add dynamic modules, update module definitions
Not supported: removing modules, installing apps, managing Jira issues

data.name: Submit DevOps Components
data.description:
Update / insert DevOps Component data.
Components are identified by their ID, and existing Component data for the same ID will be replaced if it exists and the updateSequenceNumber of existing data is less than the incoming data.
Submissions are performed asynchronously. Submitted data will eventually be available in Jira; most updates are available within a short period of time, but may take some time during peak load and/or maintenance times. The getComponentById operation can be used to confirm that da
data.evaluateGuide:
Submits or replaces DevOps Component data in Jira. Processing is asynchronous, and submitted components can be verified later by ID.
Use for: submit component data, update DevOps components, sync component metadata
Not supported: retrieving components, deleting components, creating Jira issues

data.name: Add gadget to dashboard
data.description:
Add gadget to dashboard
Adds a gadget to a dashboard.
Permissions required: None.
Parameters
| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| dashboardId | path | Yes | The ID of the dashboard. |
Response Codes

200 Returned if the request is successful.
400 Returned if the request is invalid.
401 Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.
404 Returned if the dashboard is not found.
data.evaluateGuide:
Adds a gadget to a specified Jira dashboard. Supply the dashboard identifier and the gadget payload to place it on that dashboard.
Use for: add dashboard gadget, configure dashboard layout, place app gadget
Not supported: creating dashboards, removing gadgets, editing gadget content
